name: telegram-sync
description: Single-source Telegram universe for the gateway-level wraps-real E2E. Its fake-corpus.json drives the synth twin, which runs the REAL Telegram provider, archive, history walk and normalizer over the in-memory SimulatedTelegram: a private chat over two days with a voice note and a text attachment, a supergroup with a reply, an archived basic group, Saved Messages, a forum with two topics, and a broadcast channel that stays out because channels are opt-in.
